The physical layer offers two transport channels to MAC, one is for reader to device (R2D) and the other is for device to reader (D2R).
The physical layer offers data transport services to higher layers. The access to these services is through the use of a transport channel via the MAC sub-layer.

physical layer is based on Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) with a cyclic prefix (CP)
